subject.title: [Bug]: restart storm from telegram.retry.jitter type mismatch + misleading doctor SecretRef for Telegram token

question: After the linked retry-jitter migration is resolved, should this umbrella issue stay open for SecretRef/CDP/multi-runtime hardening or be split into narrower follow-ups?
rationale: The source-reproducible jitter branch has an open fix candidate, but the remaining diagnostics and service-isolation requests cross security, doctor UX, and supervisor policy boundaries.

options.title: Land/split scope
options.body: Use the linked PR for the boolean jitter migration and move any remaining SecretRef and service-isolation work into separate focused issues.

options.title: Keep umbrella open
options.body: Keep this issue as the canonical tracker for the full cascade, accepting that it will need manual scoping before more repair work starts.

options.title: Close after jitter only
options.body: Treat the jitter migration as the only actionable repo bug here and ask for new reports if the SecretRef or CDP behavior still reproduces.

recommendation.title: Land/split scope
recommendation.body: Use the linked PR for the boolean jitter migration and move any remaining SecretRef and service-isolation work into separate focused issues.
